title: Cold Email Outbound Expert Consultant (deliverability & infrastructure)
systemName: Your outbound audit and deliverability plan

facts: Post asks for an audit of domains, mailboxes, SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warm-up, volumes, rotation; an infrastructure and deliverability plan; a sequence/testing playbook and KPI dashboard definition; ongoing advisory calls.
Post names Instantly, Smartlead, lemlist, Apollo, Clay, custom SMTP and n8n. No native sending-tool adapter exists, so the mechanism is shown in n8n and the audit/plan on the custom workbench.
The post's 10M+ emails requirement is not an approved fact about Lorenzo and is not claimed anywhere.

scenes.caption: The audit shows why the domain struggled and what to change first.
scenes.beat: This is how each finding reads in the written audit. On {{domain.name}}, DMARC was only monitoring, warm-up stopped after nine days, the list wasn't verified and each inbox sent {{stats.perInbox}} a day. So the fix is to verify the list, restart warm-up, turn on DMARC reports and drop to {{plan.start}} a day before ramping back up.
